title: Meeting Rooms II
prompt:
Given meeting `intervals`, return the minimum number of rooms required so no two overlapping meetings share a room.

**Example**: `[[0,30],[5,10],[15,20]]` → `2`.

Sort by start; a min-heap of end times tracks rooms in use — reuse a room whose meeting has ended.
hints: Min-heap holds end times of ongoing meetings. For each meeting, if the earliest end ≤ its start, that room frees up — poll it.
Always offer the current meeting's end; the heap size at the end is the room count.

solution.explanation: Processing meetings in start order, the heap's minimum end time tells you whether any room has freed up before this meeting begins. Reusing it when possible keeps the heap size equal to the peak number of simultaneous meetings — exactly the rooms needed. O(n log n).
